New distribution center coming to Jackson Co. will employ nearly 150

# New distribution center coming to Jackson Co. will employ nearly 150

Posted by kenstanford on September 9, 2026 in Local News, Local Business 

A new distribution center is coming to Jackson County, bringing with it 140 new jobs.

Parts Town Unlimited, a distributor of OEM (original equipment manufacturer) parts for commercial foodservice, residential appliances, and HVAC equipment, has leased a 538,000-squar-foot facility in the 85 North Business Park (Jackson 85 North) in Pendergrass and plans to move in by the end of the year.

The new facility will expand the company’s global fulfillment network to the Southeast, joining existing centers in Chicago, Phoenix and Munich. 

“Our new Global Fulfillment Center represents an important next step in the evolution of our North American distribution network and positions us to serve our customers and manufacturer partners with even greater speed, flexibility and scale,” said CEO Bill Geary.

SJH Fulfilment invests £3.5m in Greater Belfast expansion · BUSINESSFIRST

# SJH Fulfilment invests £3.5m in Greater Belfast expansion

 September 7, 2026 

 

SJH Fulfilment has announced a £3.5 million investment in a new 46,000 sq ft Greater Belfast fulfilment facility, more than doubling its total warehousing footprint and supporting 25 permanent jobs at the site within the next three years.

The new facility takes the company’s total warehousing footprint in Northern Ireland to 83,500 sq ft, up from 37,500 sq ft at its Kilkeel base. The additional capacity will support larger fulfilment contracts across the fashion, wellness and beauty sectors, while marking the launch of a new 10-year growth strategy targeting revenues of £50 million by 2036. Five full-time employees have already been recruited at the new site, with a further 20 permanent roles expected to be created over the next three years. An additional 10 seasonal positions will be added this winter.

The Burnaby-based third-party logistics provider said it has signed a long-term lease for the Delta facility and officially took possession Aug. 1. The company expects the site to be fully operational within about 60 days following installation of 12,000 pallet positions beginning in September.
